source.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, Poverty Thresholds for 2024 by Size of Family and Number of Related Children Under 18 Years (https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/cps/tables/time-series/historical-poverty-thresholds/thresh24.xlsx), the official measure's cash-income line.

unit: dollars a year; multiply by minorPerDollar for the ledger's minor units
note: The unit is a household (the census unit is a family or unrelated individual); its eldest member stands for the householder, and every member under 18 counts as a related child. A one-person or two-person unit has separate lines when the householder is 65 or older.
bySizeNote: Index is the number of related children under 18 (none, one, two, ...); nine people or more use the last row.
